versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart G — Operating Limitations and Information
versions.text: The following airspeed limitations shall be shown on placards in view of the pilot: (a) Maximum speed with landing gear extended, if the airplane is equipped with retractable landing gear. (bo) Minimum control speed with one engine inoperative, for multiengine airplanes, (c) Rough air or maneuvering speed determined in accordance with § 3.741,
